title: Goal: make plan files written by the `create_plan` tool easy for a human to read and properly formatted Markdown. Repo:…
summary: Now the PlanFile impl.Now tests.Plan files now open with a readable title, overview and todo checklist, and `sync_todo_list` keeps the checklist up to date. The new plan tests pass, but the `aura-ui-terminal` test run had 4 failures in chat renderer tests, which look unrelated to plans (details under Test results).
